name: comp-386
title: Paginated Tour Tooltip
description: A button opens a tour popover that pages through five short tips. Each page shows a heading, a sentence, a step counter and left/right arrows; the left arrow is disabled on the first step.
use: A few short tips need to be shown next to a control without leaving the page.
avoid: It is a click-through popover with no anchor highlighting, so it does not point at the UI it describes.
a11y: Arrows have aria-labels and disabled states are real; the popover body is not tied to the trigger for screen readers. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark popover floats above an outlined 'Tooltip-like with nav' button. Inside are a bold tip title, two or three lines of grey description, a small '1/5' counter at the lower left and two minimal arrow buttons at the lower right, the left one faded when disabled.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens the popover on the first tip. The arrows move forward and back through five tips, updating the title, text and counter; the left arrow is disabled at the start and the right at the end.
customise: The five tip titles and descriptions live in an array in the file; changing the tour means editing that array, while arrows and counter are fixed.
weight: light: One small popover swapping text; no images or animation loop.
demo: Trigger 'Tooltip-like with nav'; tips Welcome, Quick Actions, Need Help?, Keyboard Shortcuts, Stay Updated.
issues: The popover has no arrow, so it floats unanchored above the trigger.
The left arrow is dimmed only by disabled styling, which is easy to miss.
polishWhy: Clear, compact tour popover; plain styling and no anchor arrow keep it ordinary.
